mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 2.0% signals a tightening monetary policy environment that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% indicates a tight labor market that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE falls below 3.5%, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.4 million units signals strong household demand and rising inflationary pressures, which triggers a hawkish monetary policy response and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1400.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 104.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity and a contraction in real output, which signals an impending recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when INDPRO falls below 104.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL above 295.0 and FEDFUNDS above 2.0% indicates a high-inflation, high-rate regime where monetary policy is restrictive and equity valuations are compressed, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both CPIAUCSL > 295.0 and FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in UNRATE below 3.7% and rise in PAYEMS above 152,700 thousand indicates a labor market tightening that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to a hawkish policy response and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when both UNRATE < 3.7 and PAYEMS > 152700, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 680,000 million dollars combined with rising housing starts (HOUST > 1440) signals strong aggregate demand and inflationary pressure, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to anticipated rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS > 680000 and HOUST > 1440, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05 in interaction model).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO below 104.0 combined with a drop in GDPC1 below 19,700 billion indicates a weakening real economy and a contraction in output, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to recession fears.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when both INDPRO < 104.0 and GDPC1 < 19700, or the joint signal fails to produce a Rank IC > 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
